subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: May gateway identity projections omit configured local avatars above 256 KiB, or must those avatars remain visible through thumbnailing or lazy fetching?
rationale: The PR deliberately trades existing large-avatar visibility for bounded response size; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the intended long-term client behavior.

options.title: Allow bounded omission
options.body: Accept missing `avatarUrl` for local avatars above 256 KiB after the warning is bounded and real client fallback is proven.

options.title: Require visible thumbnails
options.body: Pause this patch and implement resizing, metadata stripping, or lazy avatar fetching so accepted large avatars remain visible.

recommendation.title: Allow bounded omission
recommendation.body: Accept missing `avatarUrl` for local avatars above 256 KiB after the warning is bounded and real client fallback is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared avatar policy and gateway behavior affected by the compatibility choice.
